description: Move 2 to 25 findings to the same status in one change, such as acknowledging a batch after triage, as the Findings page's bulk action does. Odin refuses findings Borg has closed and reports how many changed. Use update_finding_status for one finding. Requires an explicit user request and the Member role or above. Requires write permission.

comment.description: Optional note recorded with each status change.

expectedStatuses.description: The status each finding should still have, keyed by findingId, as last read. A finding whose status has changed since, or that has no entry, is left alone.

findingIds.description: findingId values (not identifiers such as ODI-12) from list_findings or get_finding.

status.description: Target status for every finding. MITIGATING means work has started, OPEN_FOR_RETEST means the fix is ready for verification, and ACKNOWLEDGED means the organisation accepts the risk for now.

name: update_findings_status
title: Update several findings' status
